counter <- "execution-count.txt"
count <- if (file.exists(counter)) as.integer(readChar(counter, file.info(counter)$size)) else 0L
cat(count + 1L, file=counter)
svg <- paste0('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="160" height="80"><rect width="160" height="80" fill="green"/><text x="8" y="45">COMPUTED ', 6 * 7, '</text></svg>')
cat(svg, file="computed.svg")
